description: The plot illustrates how a similarity metric varies across model layers for four language-pair conditions, shown as four colored lines. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately layers 1 through 22 with regularly spaced tick labels at even numbers (2, 4, 6, …, 22). The y-axis is labeled “Similarity,” uses a linear scale, and shows values from about 0.05 up to about 0.45 with evenly spaced tick marks at roughly 0.05 intervals. The red solid line (en&en) starts near 0.10 at the first layer, rises to about 0.15–0.18 by around layer 3, spikes to roughly 0.33–0.34 near layer 4, drops to about 0.24–0.25 around layers 5–6, then fluctuates around ~0.27–0.30 through the mid layers (around layers 9–15), stays near ~0.26–0.28 through about layers 16–21, and ends with a sharp jump at the final layer to above 0.45. The blue solid line (en&es) begins around 0.08–0.09, increases to ~0.14–0.16 by about layer 3, peaks near ~0.31–0.32 around layer 4, declines to ~0.23–0.25 around layers 5–7, rises again to ~0.29–0.30 around layers 10–11, then gently varies around ~0.25–0.29 through layers ~12–21, finishing with a steep increase at the last layer to roughly the low-to-mid 0.40s. The green solid line (en&el) starts near ~0.06–0.07, climbs to ~0.11–0.12 by about layer 2–3, rises to ~0.21–0.22 around layer 5, dips to ~0.18–0.19 around layer 6, then increases to ~0.26–0.27 around layers 10–11, fluctuates around ~0.23–0.26 through about layers 12–21, and ends with a sharp final-layer jump to roughly the mid 0.40s. The magenta solid line (en&bn) begins around ~0.05–0.06, increases to ~0.10–0.11 by about layer 2–3, rises to ~0.21 around layer 5, dips to ~0.17–0.18 around layer 6, then climbs to ~0.26–0.27 around layers 10–11, varies around ~0.22–0.25 through layers ~12–21, and finishes with a pronounced spike at the last layer to roughly the low-to-mid 0.40s.
